dataFlow: User invokes activity tool → TemplateSelector checks A/B candidates → MetabobCLI.recommendActivities via MCP → metabob_recommend_activities MCP tool → RPC API recommend_activities → Thompson Sampling (Redis cache + Beta sampling) → SelectionResult → Activity execution → Impulse tracking → Activity.complete() → TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution (non-blocking) → MCP metabob_post_activity_result → RPC record_execution (201 immediate) → Background task writes (activity_executions, template_metrics alpha/beta update, impulse_usage, component_changes) → Redis cache update → Learning loop feedback (updated metrics influence next Thompson Sampling) → Boredom detection (idle session) → fetch_boredom_activities → improvement_gradient query → Execute improvement meta-activity (closes loop)

components.currentBehavior: Entry point that validates template variables, creates isolated activity session, delegates template selection to TemplateSelector
Checks for A/B testing candidates, calls MetabobCLI.recommendActivities for Thompson Sampling, falls back to stable template on MCP failure
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - graceful degradation working

components.currentBehavior: Wraps MCP protocol call, provides graceful degradation (returns empty array on failure), 10-second timeout protection
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - but needs versioning support
components.gap: MEDIUM: No versioning in MCP tool names - breaking changes invisible

components.currentBehavior: Extracts org_id from MCP context (multi-tenant isolation), forwards request to backend API, handles timeouts and errors
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - but needs retry logic
components.gap: MEDIUM: No retry logic for transient HTTP failures

components.currentBehavior: Queries templates filtered by category and org_id, loads alpha/beta parameters from Redis cache, samples from Beta(alpha, beta) distribution, ranks by sampled value
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - but needs Redis error handling and rate limiting
components.gap: CRITICAL: No error handling for Redis connection failures - would crash Thompson Sampling endpoint. MEDIUM: No rate limiting (10/min recommended)

components.currentBehavior: Calculates duration/cost/tokens, collects impulse usage (only loaded impulses), extracts component changes, normalizes cache tokens, reports via non-blocking MCP with empty catch block
components.desiredBehavior: Same collection logic - but needs logging/monitoring for failures
components.gap: HIGH: Empty catch block swallows errors - learning loop degradation invisible. Needs logging, monitoring, alerts

components.currentBehavior: Packages execution data for backend, makes non-blocking MCP call (fire-and-forget), silent failures
components.desiredBehavior: Same fire-and-forget pattern - but needs observability
components.gap: HIGH: Silent failures prevent monitoring learning loop health

components.currentBehavior: Returns 201 immediately (non-blocking), schedules background task for database writes, defaults timestamps if not provided, extracts template_id from activity_id if missing (fragile fallback)
components.desiredBehavior: Keep non-blocking pattern - but require template_id explicitly and monitor background task failures
components.gap: MEDIUM: Fragile template_id extraction fallback. HIGH: Background task failures only logged, not monitored - data integrity issues invisible

components.currentBehavior: Inserts to activity_executions, updates template_metrics (alpha/beta), inserts to impulse_usage, inserts to component_changes, updates Redis cache
components.desiredBehavior: Same write pattern - but needs retry queue and monitoring
components.gap: HIGH: Database write failures invisible to caller - needs retry queue, monitoring, alerts

components.currentBehavior: Matches loaded impulses to context requirements, calculates relevance scores (pattern matching + priority), buffers learning records for batch sending
components.desiredBehavior: Same pattern matching - but needs content hash tracking
components.gap: MEDIUM: Missing content_hash field - can't detect when impulse content changes, learning quality scores inaccurate

components.currentBehavior: Checks if session idle and no boredom activity running, fetches boredom activities via MCP, selects highest priority activity, executes improvement meta-activity
Queries templates with improvement_gradient < threshold, excludes templates executed in last N hours, calculates priority: (1 - improvement_gradient) × staleness_factor, determines activity type

critical.issue: No error handling for Redis.get() in Thompson Sampling
critical.impact: Complete system failure if Redis unavailable

high.impact: Learning loop breaks invisibly, recommendations become stale

high.issue: Database write failures only logged, not monitored
high.mitigation: Add monitoring, retry queue for failed tasks

medium.issue: No versioning in MCP tool names
medium.impact: Tool signature changes break clients silently, deployment coordination required
medium.mitigation: Add version suffix to tool names (e.g., _v1)

medium.issue: Fragile parsing of activity ID to extract template ID
medium.impact: Wrong metrics if activity ID format changes

medium.issue: No retry logic for transient network issues
medium.mitigation: Add exponential backoff retry with tenacity

medium.impact: Can't detect when impulse content changes, learning quality scores inaccurate
medium.mitigation: Add content_hash field to impulse usage

medium.issue: No rate limiting on Thompson Sampling endpoint
medium.impact: Malicious or buggy clients can overload backend
